output.reason: The linked PR [ev-65a25141c539] says that Argo CD 3.0.0 now shows an error message in the UI log viewer when the max-pods limit is reached, which is when a Deployment or ReplicaSet has more than 10 pods. That gives the subject: the UI pod logs viewer, changed in pod-logs-viewer.tsx and requests.ts [ev-9279da13955a]. It also gives the applicability: viewing logs in the UI for a workload with more than 10 pods. The release note [ev-ea73ef1da3cb] lists it as a UI-only bug fix, and no source names a configuration change or an operational consequence. That is enough to type it as an informational UI behaviour change, but the earlier behaviour is shown only in a screenshot that isn't available here.
